description: Answers the profile of the open DIYA-GL book: the product, the accounting period, the business (name, trade, address, VAT registration, cash or accruals basis), the tax settings, the bank accounts, the journals with their line counts and dates, and the registers it carries (directors, employees, debtors, creditors, fixed assets, dividends, members, opening balances, stock). Use this when the person asks what period their records cover, whether they are VAT registered, or who their directors or employees are. It does not change the book.
name: book
title: Profile of a DIYA-GL book
